# netmaker_device (Resource)

Provisions a fresh machine as a Netmaker device (Host): installs a pinned netclient version and joins it to the network(s) covered by the given enrollment key. Always provisions a new host — does not adopt an existing one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deploy` (Attributes) How to provision this device: the enrollment-key token to join with, and the mechanism used to reach the machine. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy))
- `name` (String) Device name, passed to `netclient join -o` and used to locate the resulting device after joining. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether netclient keeps itself updated to the latest release instead of a pinned version. Forced to false whenever netclient_version is set. Exactly one of netclient_version or auto_update = true must be set. Changing this only flips the device's server-side auto_update flag — no reinstall.
- `netclient_version` (String) netclient release version to install, e.g. "v1.2.0" (see https://github.com/gravitl/netclient/releases). Mutually exclusive with auto_update = true — exactly one of the two must be set. Changing this swaps the installed version in place (`netclient use`) rather than reinstalling/rejoining.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned device (host) ID.
- `nodes` (List of String) IDs of the Node records created by joining (one per network the enrollment key covers).
- `os` (String) Detected target OS: linux, darwin, or windows.

<a id="nestedatt--deploy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deploy`

Required:

- `mode` (Attributes) Deploy mechanism. SSH is currently the only one supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy--mode))
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Join token from a netmaker_enrollment_key (its `token` attribute). Determines which network(s) the device joins.

<a id="nestedatt--deploy--mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deploy.mode`

Required:

- `ssh` (Attributes) Connect and deploy over SSH. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deploy--mode--ssh))

<a id="nestedatt--deploy--mode--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deploy.mode.ssh`

Required:

- `host_ip` (String) IP address (or hostname) of the target machine.
- `username` (String) SSH username.

Optional:

- `host_port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to 22.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password. Only used if neither private_key nor private_key_path is set.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded SSH private key content. Mutually exclusive with private_key_path; use exactly one of private_key/private_key_path, or password.
- `private_key_path` (String) Path to a PEM-encoded SSH private key file, read from the machine running Terraform. Mutually exclusive with private_key; use exactly one of private_key/private_key_path, or password.
